items.question: Which neighbourhoods are most densely populated?
items.method: Kontur H3 hexagon populations are apportioned to each OSM neighbourhood polygon by intersection area (assumes people are spread evenly inside each ~0.74 km² hexagon), then divided by the neighbourhood's land area inside the study area. Neighbourhoods with <1,000 people or <0.4 km² are excluded.

items.question: How many residents live within 500 m of a park?
items.method: Straight-line distance from each hexagon centre to the nearest OSM park, garden or recreation ground of at least 0.5 ha. Grass verges and road medians are excluded. Straight-line distance overstates real walking access.

items.question: How many residents live within 800 m of a metro station?
items.method: Straight-line distance from each hexagon centre to the nearest Riyadh Metro station mapped in OSM inside the study area. Population is from Nov 2023, before the metro opened (Dec 2024 – Jan 2025), so this describes coverage, not ridership.

items.question: Where is the major-road network most concentrated?
items.method: Length of OSM motorway, trunk, primary, secondary and tertiary roads (incl. links) inside each neighbourhood, divided by its area. Residential streets are excluded.

items.question: Do denser neighbourhoods have less green space?
items.method: Rank correlation between population density and the share of land mapped as green in OSM, across neighbourhoods. −1 = denser always less green, 0 = no relationship. Correlation is not causation, and OSM green mapping completeness varies.
